correctness.rationale: An outbreak cluster on a path is 1+G_a+G_{m-a} with independent truncated Bernoulli-success runs. The tail-sum formula gives V_t(p)=sum_{j=1}^t j p^j -sum_{j=t+1}^{2t}(2t+1-j)p^j exactly. For D=V_a+V_{m-a}-V_c-V_{m-c}, coefficient regions are negative/positive/nonpositive and D(1)=0. Quotient D/(1-p) has prefix-sum coefficients with exactly one sign change. Descartes gives at most one positive zero counted with multiplicity, and D negative near zero while positive near one by strict convexity of sum_{j<=t}j^2, forcing one simple crossing. Mean comparison is positive by pairing short powers. Exact independent brute edge enumeration verifies 52 source moment polynomials, 3080 pair sign-certificate cases (m<=41), and the six-vertex rational signs. Finite checks corroborate only.

evidence: Nov8 seven-vertex tree theorem establishes that two reversals can occur on general trees; that does not force exactly one on paths.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Broader graph classes / percolation techniques are not stronger single-crossing inequalities. A general-tree double-crossing example cannot entail this path-specific all-pair sign-variation theorem.
